matches.title: Directory sync adapter boundaries
matches.summary: Synthetic page covering request construction, page traversal and throttling boundaries.
matches.content: For directory synchronization, graph-client owns page traversal and 429 backoff retries. directory-sync consumes the paged result and does not repeat retries. Field selection is fixed in the graph-client request builder; the adapter does not choose fields again.
